entry.title: 新标签页里的 sessionStorage，为什么会带着旧值？
entry.summary: sessionStorage 可从 opener 初始复制，之后独立；重载不等于清空，草稿应关联任务与恢复条件。

entry.summary: Preserve task identity and dependent answers during pre-submission correction.

entry.summary: Define error-budget restrictions, exceptions and release evidence before urgent decisions.

entry.summary: Separate ignoring, tracking state, historical content and secret-response responsibilities.

entry.summary: Compare lengths only across matching units and representation layers.

entry.summary: Preserve exact identifiers before numeric conversion and inspect every transport boundary.

entry.summary: Verify image digests and actual pull policy without treating cache reuse as stale deployment.

entry.title: Separate visual transparency from interaction availability
entry.summary: Coordinate transparency, interaction availability and focus instead of relying on appearance.

entry.summary: Classify operation status separately from exception events and verify context ownership.

entry.summary: Assert task-specific readiness rather than inferring completion from quiet connections.

entry.summary: Separate numeric rounding, input acceptance and calculation policy.

entry.summary: Distinguish allocated sequence values from committed records and completed business work.

entry.summary: Trace recorded metric identity through expressions, label overrides and downstream consumers.

entry.summary: Separate main-operation outcomes from cleanup failures and retry decisions.

entry.summary: Review XPASS behavior and exception ownership against current pytest settings.

entry.summary: Constrain navigation destinations with approved mappings and explicit parsed-component checks.

entry.title: Understand per-tab storage without assuming a blank initial state
entry.summary: Model initial storage copying, independent tab changes and draft recovery explicitly.

entry.title: 收到 429 后，什么时候重试才有依据？
entry.summary: 429 不定义所有配额范围，Retry-After 也不保证再次成功；用总预算、取消和结果状态约束重试。

entry.title: 只改一个字段，为什么不能把 PUT 当作局部更新？
entry.summary: PUT 替换表示与 PATCH 修改指令不同；明确省略、空值、重复执行和并发条件，避免由实现偶然决定更新含义。

entry.title: npm audit fix --force 修复了报告，就能直接发布吗？
entry.summary: 强制修复可能跨版本范围；报告阈值不清除问题，发布需核对实际依赖变更和业务回归。

entry.title: 镜像中的文件换了，挂载卷里为什么还是旧内容？
entry.summary: 空卷首次复制不是持续同步，已有卷遮住镜像目录；迁移与镜像回退需要独立的数据兼容证据。

entry.title: 功能已经全量开放，开关为什么还需要退役计划？
entry.summary: 功能开关按用途定义寿命、负责人和退役条件，清理临时分支与维护长期控制需要不同契约。

entry.title: 二分定位到了提交，为什么还不能直接宣布根因？
entry.summary: 二分定位依赖可信好坏判定；环境失败应区分，跳过与不稳定性保持未知，提交身份不等于根因。

entry.title: revert 之后，原来的提交为什么还在历史里？
entry.summary: revert 新增反向提交而不删除历史；合并父节点和当前差异需审查，源码变化不代替运行恢复。

entry.title: await 网络请求以后，IndexedDB 事务为什么已经结束？
entry.summary: IndexedDB 活动事务受任务边界约束；准备输入后再写，单请求成功不代表整笔事务完成。

entry.title: 列表排序后，原来的数组为什么也变了？
entry.summary: sort 修改原数组，复制容器也可能共享对象；明确展示顺序、记录所有权和比较规则。

entry.title: CronJob 按时创建了 Job，就能保证业务只执行一次吗？
entry.summary: CronJob 不保证业务恰好一次；计划时间、业务身份、并发范围和重试结果需要分别记录。

entry.title: 日志里有 TraceId，就一定能打开完整链路吗？
entry.summary: TraceId 提供关联身份，不保证链路已保留；核对上下文归属、采样、查询范围与访问条件。

entry.title: 每组只取一条记录，怎样确定拿到的是哪一条？
entry.summary: DISTINCT ON 需要明确组内优先级；代表行不是组汇总，并列与迟到数据要有选择依据。

entry.title: NOT IN 为什么没有返回预期的未匹配记录？
entry.summary: NOT IN 遇到空值可能返回未知；先定义身份缺失的业务规则，再核对排除查询与改写等价性。

entry.title: 时间字符串带偏移，数据库为什么没有按时区转换？
entry.summary: 时间输入偏移是否参与解释取决于类型；区分时间点、本地时间、显示时区与历史来源。

entry.title: 指标消失了，为什么不能直接当作零流量？
entry.summary: 缺少样本不是零流量；根据预期目标检查采集覆盖，总体数值不能证明每个实例完整。

entry.title: 实验室任务顺利，为什么还要观察用户自己的设备？
entry.summary: 用参与者自己的设备与材料识别任务环境，区分界面问题、协作等待与干扰，不把受控会话外推为日常保证。

entry.title: 给 CDN 脚本加了 integrity，为什么仍加载失败？
entry.summary: SRI 同时依赖预期字节与跨源条件；哈希匹配不证明代码可信，更新和回退需要维护审查关系。

entry.title: 测试替换了全局函数，怎样限制它影响的范围？
entry.summary: 限制全局补丁影响范围与恢复时机；恢复引用不回滚外部副作用，环境变量还需核对读取时机。

entry.title: 固定 Date 以后，定时器为什么仍按真实时间运行？
entry.summary: 固定日期与推进定时器不同；核对安装顺序、版本与后端时间边界，仍需业务结果断言。

entry.title: 用 URL 拼接口地址，末尾斜杠为什么会改变结果？
entry.summary: URL 按目录与源解析相对地址，斜杠影响路径；语法解析成功不能替代目的地授权。

entry.summary: Distinguish replacement from patch instructions, including omissions, nulls and concurrency.

entry.summary: Review forced dependency fixes for compatibility rather than treating a cleaner report as acceptance.

entry.summary: Separate initial volume copying from image updates, migrations and data-compatible rollback.

entry.summary: Define flag ownership and retirement while treating long-lived operational controls separately.

entry.summary: Use a reliable bisect predicate and preserve uncertainty before making causal claims.

entry.summary: Separate array ordering, record mutation and shared input ownership.

entry.title: Give scheduled work a business identity beyond its Job
entry.summary: Give scheduled work stable business identity and durable outcomes beyond Job creation.

entry.title: Correlate logs with trace context without promising retained spans
entry.summary: Correlate logs using real context while preserving trace-retention and visibility limits.

entry.summary: Define representative-row precedence and validate ties and late arrivals before deduplication.

entry.title: Keep null semantics visible in exclusion queries
entry.summary: Preserve unknown identity semantics when designing and rewriting exclusion queries.

entry.title: Choose timestamp types from the meaning of the stored value
entry.summary: Choose timestamp storage from instant or local-time meaning and preserve original zone intent separately.

entry.title: Treat missing telemetry separately from a measured zero
entry.summary: Keep missing telemetry distinct from measured zero and inspect expected target coverage.

entry.title: Observe the task context beyond a controlled research session
entry.summary: Inspect real task constraints without treating a controlled session as everyday-use proof.

entry.summary: Align expected bytes and cross-origin permissions without treating integrity as code trust.

entry.title: Limit monkeypatch scope and restore temporary dependencies
entry.summary: Limit patch scope and distinguish restored references from undone external effects.

entry.title: Control date values and timer progression deliberately
entry.summary: Control date values and timer progression according to the behavior being tested.

entry.title: Resolve relative URLs with an explicit base-path contract
entry.summary: Make base-path semantics explicit and keep URL parsing separate from destination permission.

entry.title: 工作流被路径过滤跳过，为什么 PR 仍在等检查？
entry.summary: 工作流过滤跳过可能让必需检查待定；区分作业跳过与实际成功，让门禁对应当前提交和真实结果。

entry.title: CSP nonce 应该跟着构建，还是跟着响应变化？
entry.summary: CSP nonce 按响应生成且与许可标签匹配；缓存和模板注入需共同检查，不对未知脚本无差别授权。

entry.title: 容器停机信号为什么没到应用进程？
entry.summary: 先确认入口进程与信号交接，再评估停机时间；exec 改变清理责任，启动成功不证明结束正确。

entry.title: 下载文件名为什么不能直接当作本地路径？
entry.summary: 下载文件名只是建议；分别控制保存目录、存储身份和内容处理，国际化解析不替代安全判断。

entry.title: HEAD 返回 200，为什么仍需验证 GET 正文？
entry.summary: HEAD 成功不验证 GET 正文；结合访问条件核对内容、元数据和实际发布范围。

entry.title: 故障处理中，谁来决定优先级和接手时机？
entry.summary: 故障管理明确指挥、操作、沟通与交接责任；假设、影响和恢复证据分开，兼任也需明确归属。

entry.title: 配置 PDB 后，哪些中断仍然可能发生？
entry.summary: PDB 约束特定自愿中断，不能阻止节点故障或代替滚动更新策略；副本数量也不证明服务容量。

entry.title: 网络分块切断中文字符，应该在哪一层处理？
entry.summary: 保留跨块字符的解码状态，再独立处理消息分帧、大小上限和输入结束；正确解码不代表消息完整。

entry.title: write 返回 false 后，Node.js 流应该怎样继续？
entry.summary: write 返回 false 后等待 drain；highWaterMark 是阈值，背压与取消、缓冲预算及业务确认需要分别设计。

entry.title: Delta 和 Cumulative 指标为什么不能混着相加？
entry.summary: Delta 与 Cumulative 的区间语义不同；保留起止时间、序列身份及重启处理，避免重复计算或假定缺失为零。

entry.title: 改完密码，旧登录会话就一定失效了吗？
entry.summary: 密码恢复还需旧会话与恢复渠道策略；疑似失陷时核对控制权，不能仅以新密码可用宣布恢复。

entry.title: 定位到两个按钮时，为什么不该直接加 first？
entry.summary: 定位器歧义先确认业务身份与区域；first 只选择位置，不证明目标正确，等待也不能消除身份问题。

entry.title: 连接池里的 PostgreSQL 咨询锁，什么时候才会释放？
entry.summary: 咨询锁按会话或事务释放，连接归还不等于会话结束；检查重复取得、清理与外部副作用边界。

entry.title: 计数器重启过，为什么要先 rate 再 sum？
entry.summary: 先对每条计数器求 rate，再汇总以保留重置信息；窗口、指标类型与实例排查需要分别解释。

entry.title: 原型已经能用，为什么还不能直接上线？
entry.summary: 原型用于研究假设，生产承担真实数据与运行责任；逐项确认复用条件，不以可点击页面代替上线验收。

entry.title: pytest 参数化测试为什么会互相改到输入？
entry.summary: 参数化不自动复制输入；核对共享对象、嵌套可变值和预期结果，避免只修复当前运行顺序。

entry.title: useId 解决什么身份问题，又不能替代什么？
entry.summary: useId 用于可访问性关联，不替代列表键或业务主键；服务端渲染需两侧组件树一致。

entry.title: 研究笔记怎样区分观察、解释和下一步行动？
entry.summary: 研究笔记把观察、解释与行动分开，保留原话出处和竞争假设，不把会议共识当作更多用户证据。

entry.title: SQLite 声明了外键，为什么还要检查每条连接？
entry.summary: SQLite 外键需在每条连接确认执行，并在事务外配置；表定义和开启开关都不能证明历史数据正确。

entry.title: 移动端看着正常，放大后为什么仍可能不可用？
entry.summary: 放大重排需保留信息与功能；分别检查手机和桌面放大，二维内容例外不覆盖整张页面。

entry.summary: Keep required-check results tied to the current commit when workflows or jobs are skipped.

entry.summary: Generate response-scoped CSP nonces and keep policy, approved tags and caches consistent.

entry.summary: Inspect entrypoint process ownership and signal handoff before evaluating shutdown budgets.

entry.title: Treat a download filename as a suggestion, not a local path
entry.summary: Separate suggested download names from authorized destinations and permitted content handling.

entry.title: A successful HEAD response does not verify the GET body
entry.summary: Verify GET content under the reader’s access conditions beyond successful HEAD metadata.

entry.title: Assign incident command before parallel fixes collide
entry.summary: Coordinate incident roles, active changes and accepted handovers with explicit evidence limits.

entry.title: Use a PodDisruptionBudget within its disruption scope
entry.summary: Review PDB disruption scope separately from rollouts, fault domains and service capacity.

entry.title: Decode split text characters without confusing them with message frames
entry.summary: Preserve split-character decoding state, then apply independent framing and end-of-input rules.

entry.title: Respect writable backpressure before sending more chunks
entry.summary: Respect backpressure and define cancellation, buffer budgets and business acknowledgment separately.

entry.title: Preserve metric temporality before combining reported values
entry.summary: Preserve metric intervals and temporality across collection, conversion and restart boundaries.

entry.title: Password recovery needs an explicit session-revocation policy
entry.summary: Define session and recovery-channel handling beyond acceptance of a new password.

entry.title: Resolve locator ambiguity before choosing the first match
entry.summary: Resolve locator identity and scope before relying on positional selection or longer waits.

entry.title: Advisory-lock ownership must match the connection lifetime
entry.summary: Match advisory-lock scope to pooled-session ownership and explicit cleanup boundaries.

entry.title: Calculate each counter rate before aggregating replicas
entry.summary: Preserve counter-reset context by calculating per-series rates before aggregation.

entry.title: A working prototype still needs a production boundary
entry.summary: Evaluate production responsibilities separately from the interaction a prototype helps study.

entry.title: Avoid mutable aliases between parametrized test cases
entry.summary: Inspect mutable aliases and independent expectations instead of relying on test ordering.

entry.title: Use React useId for accessibility relationships, not data identity
entry.summary: Use useId for accessibility relationships while preserving data identity and matching render trees.

entry.title: Separate research observations from interpretations and actions
entry.summary: Keep observed research evidence, competing explanations and proposed actions distinct.

entry.title: Verify SQLite foreign-key enforcement on each connection
entry.summary: Check foreign-key enforcement per SQLite connection before transactions, without assuming historical validity.

entry.title: Test zoom reflow separately from a narrow mobile viewport
entry.summary: Verify information and operations after zoom reflow, keeping two-dimensional exceptions local.

entry.title: 提交显示 Verified，就代表代码已经审查了吗？
entry.summary: Verified 说明签名验证，不能代替代码批准；把签名、审查、检查与部署分别绑定具体提交。

entry.title: ConfigMap 改了，应用为什么还在用旧配置？
entry.summary: ConfigMap 更新与应用采用是不同阶段；区分环境变量、挂载与 subPath，并记录有效配置版本。

entry.title: CORS 报错了，就能确定请求没有执行吗？
entry.summary: CORS 错误不能证明业务未执行；区分预检和响应读取，关联服务端证据并设计未知结果恢复。

entry.title: POST 跳转后变成 GET，服务端到底接收了什么？
entry.summary: POST 重定向需要区分方法保留与结果展示；同时检查正文重放、目标边界和重复副作用。

entry.title: 同一个网址，缓存为什么给错了语言版本？
entry.summary: Vary 参与缓存表示匹配；核对语言、默认分支与代理输出，并分别审查私人数据和授权边界。

entry.title: 页面流程通了，用户为什么仍卡在部门交接处？
entry.summary: 页面操作成功不等于用户任务完成；从跨部门交接、材料接收与责任归属识别旅程断点。

entry.title: 覆盖率很高，测试为什么仍放过错误的比较符？
entry.summary: 变异存活提示测试敏感性问题；逐项核对业务含义、输入缺口与断言，避免只为分数绑定实现细节。

entry.title: 用了 npm ci，就能保证两台机器产物完全相同吗？
entry.summary: npm ci 冻结安装不等于构建完全复现；记录运行时、参数与配置，先定义产物允许哪些差异。

entry.title: CHECK 写着大于零，为什么空值仍能保存？
entry.summary: CHECK 为真或空值都可满足；把必填、数值范围与业务阶段分别定义，避免把未知批量改成零。

entry.title: RLS 策略写好了，为什么应用仍能读到所有租户？
entry.summary: RLS 是否生效取决于运行角色和策略；区分高权限绕过、表所有者及读写路径，不以管理员查询代替验收。

entry.title: SKIP LOCKED 查不到任务，就代表队列空了吗？
entry.summary: SKIP LOCKED 的空结果不代表队列清空；分别记录领取、完成与恢复，并检查顺序和公平性需求。

entry.title: VACUUM 完成了，数据库文件为什么没有变小？
entry.summary: 普通 VACUUM 主要让空间复用，FULL 重写有额外空间和锁成本；按容量目标选择维护与验收指标。

entry.title: 多个实例的 P95，为什么不能直接取平均？
entry.summary: 实例 P95 不能直接平均成整体 P95；先定义请求总体、窗口与指标形式，再审查分布聚合和局部问题。

entry.title: 随机输入测了很多次，怎样知道断言没有写错？
entry.summary: 属性测试还需要独立正确性依据；审查业务属性、输入领域和关键案例，不把大量生成当作证明。

entry.title: 可以算出的 React 状态，为什么还要用 Effect 同步？
entry.summary: React 派生值通常在渲染时计算；区分独立编辑、外部同步与性能优化，避免维护多份重复状态。

entry.title: 关闭动画以后，用户还能看出操作状态吗？
entry.summary: 减少动态效果仍需完整状态反馈；分别检查运动、文字、脚本实现与会话中偏好变化。

entry.title: 正则能校验输入，为什么也可能拖住服务？
entry.summary: 正则校验也需要资源边界；结合模式、引擎和输入规模审查失败路径，核对处理预算能否真正停止工作。

entry.title: 同意参加访谈，就能把录音交给任何工具吗？
entry.summary: 研究同意需要关联录音、转写与分享副本；引入外部工具前核对用途、接收方与退出路径。

entry.title: structuredClone 以后，原来的 buffer 为什么不能用了？
entry.summary: transfer 会改变资源使用权；在接口中明确原持有者、异步失败和重试数据的责任。

entry.title: Webhook 的 JSON 没变，签名为什么校验失败？
entry.summary: Webhook 签名针对原始请求内容；先核对中间件、端点秘密与字节，再分别设计去重和完成记录。

entry.title: A verified signature is not a code-review receipt
entry.summary: Bind signature verification, review, checks and deployment evidence to their exact commits.

entry.title: Configuration delivery and application reload are separate events
entry.summary: Trace ConfigMap consumption, propagation and effective application versions across environment and volume boundaries.

entry.title: A CORS error does not establish that the server did nothing
entry.summary: Locate the CORS failure stage and correlate server outcomes before deciding whether a side-effecting action can be retried.

entry.title: Redirect status codes carry a request-method contract
entry.summary: Choose redirect semantics from submission intent, then inspect body replay, destinations and duplicate effects.

entry.title: A URL alone cannot identify every cached representation
entry.summary: Match cached representations against actual selection fields, including defaults and proxies, with separate privacy checks.

entry.title: Map the handoff beyond a successful page flow
entry.summary: Inspect cross-team ownership, evidence acceptance and truthful status beyond a successful page flow.

entry.title: Use surviving mutants to inspect assertion gaps
entry.summary: Interpret surviving mutants against business behavior and input gaps before adding implementation-coupled assertions.

entry.title: A frozen install is only one input to a reproducible build
entry.summary: Inventory runtime, options and configuration beyond frozen installation, then define permitted artifact differences.

entry.title: A CHECK constraint is not a required-value declaration
entry.summary: Separate CHECK ranges, required values and business stages without converting unknown data into false zeroes.

entry.title: Test row security with the actual application role
entry.summary: Verify RLS with the runtime role, separating privileged bypass, ownership and read-write paths.

entry.title: An empty SKIP LOCKED result is not an empty queue
entry.summary: Distinguish empty claims from completed queues and define durable ownership, recovery and ordering requirements.

entry.title: Reusable database space is different from a smaller file
entry.summary: Distinguish reusable space from file shrinkage and assess rewrite capacity and access costs before maintenance.

entry.title: Aggregate distributions before estimating a fleet quantile
entry.summary: Define the population, window and distribution representation before estimating a fleet quantile.

entry.title: Property tests still need an independent behavioral claim
entry.summary: Review independent properties, meaningful domains and explicit boundaries rather than treating generated input volume as proof.

entry.title: Calculate derived values before introducing synchronized state
entry.summary: Separate derived display values, independent edits and external synchronization before storing another state copy.

entry.title: Reduced motion still needs clear state feedback
entry.summary: Keep clear operation states while reducing motion across styles, scripts and preference changes.

entry.title: Regular-expression validation needs an execution budget
entry.summary: Review regex pattern, engine and input size together, including whether resource limits actually stop processing.

entry.title: Research consent needs a traceable data-use boundary
entry.summary: Trace research consent through recordings, transcripts and recipients before introducing another processing tool.

entry.title: Transferring a buffer changes ownership rather than making a second copy
entry.summary: Define buffer ownership, original-holder access and retry recovery before choosing transfer over copying.

entry.title: Verify webhook signatures before changing the request body
entry.summary: Verify original webhook bytes and endpoint secrets before parsing, with separate deduplication and completion records.

entry.title: OIDC 不再保存长期密钥，谁还能换到云权限？
entry.summary: OIDC 减少长期密钥保存，仍需限定工作流身份与云权限；核对新仓库 subject 格式和环境审批路径。

entry.title: 告警一直满足阈值，为什么迟迟没有触发？
entry.summary: 告警等待针对稳定标签集合；动态值放说明信息，区分数据缺失、规则触发与后续通知交付。

entry.title: Deployment 滚动更新完成，业务验收为什么仍未结束？
entry.summary: Deployment 更新完成需另做业务验收；连同原因与版本读取状态，进度期限不自动提供回滚。

entry.title: 文件没有提交到 Git，构建上下文里就没有它吗？
entry.summary: Git 忽略不控制 Docker 上下文；核对实际目录、忽略规则优先级与例外，并单独检查镜像产物。

entry.title: 浏览器校验通过，服务端还要检查什么？
entry.summary: 浏览器校验用于及时反馈，服务端仍需核对格式、授权和当前业务状态，并提供可修正的错误。

entry.title: 上游超时了，下游任务为什么仍在消耗资源？
entry.summary: 上游超时不证明下游停止：传播剩余预算，让执行器响应取消，并单独处理已经提交的业务副作用。

entry.title: 断点续传怎样避免拼接两个版本的文件？
entry.summary: 断点续传应绑定表示版本，核对响应范围；完整响应进入替换流程，避免把不同版本的字节拼在一起。

entry.title: JWT 签名正确，为什么仍可能用错了令牌？
entry.summary: JWT 签名有效仍需验证发行者、接受方与用途，认证之后还要检查资源权限，避免令牌跨用途混用。

entry.title: 密码哈希要升级，为什么不能只替换算法名字？
entry.summary: 密码哈希升级需保留旧验证路径，确认新记录持久化，并评估长期未登录账户、并发改密和回滚兼容。

entry.title: 点击成功后立刻断言，测试为什么偶尔失败？
entry.summary: 点击结束不证明业务完成；等待可重读的结果条件，区分短暂提示、持久状态与失败路径。

entry.title: 国际化不能只给英文单词加一个 s
entry.summary: 复数类别负责选择消息，完整句子仍需翻译；区分基数、序数、零状态与未知数量。

entry.title: 同一事务里时间没变，是数据库时钟停了吗？
entry.summary: CURRENT_TIMESTAMP 不变源于事务时间语义；按业务事件选择取时点，避免把时间戳当成全局顺序。

entry.title: 外键能级联删除，业务就应该级联吗？
entry.summary: 根据对象所有权与生命周期选择外键删除动作，审查共享引用、软删除规则与恢复边界。

entry.title: 保存点让导入继续了，怎样说明哪些记录失败？
entry.summary: 保存点只恢复局部改动，部分导入仍需明确外层提交、稳定记录身份、失败报告与重试契约。

entry.title: 复盘写了改进项，怎样确认它真的降低了风险？
entry.summary: 复盘改进项应关联失败路径与可推翻完成判断的验收证据，区分任务关闭、检测改进和风险降低。

entry.title: 扩大 fixture 作用域，测试为何开始互相影响？
entry.summary: 扩大 fixture 作用域也扩大共享状态寿命；分离昂贵资源与测试上下文，检查失败清理和并行外部资源。

entry.title: OIDC removes stored cloud keys, not the need for narrow trust
entry.summary: Narrow workflow trust and cloud roles, accounting for repository subject-format changes and approval paths.

entry.title: Changing alert labels can keep resetting the pending period
entry.summary: Stable alert identity matters to pending duration; distinguish missing data, firing and downstream delivery.

entry.title: A complete Deployment rollout still needs business acceptance
entry.summary: Separate version identity, controller completion and business acceptance; progress deadlines only signal stalled rollout.

entry.title: Git ignore rules do not define the Docker build context
entry.summary: Inspect actual context sources, ignore precedence and exceptions, then verify build artifacts separately.

entry.title: What the server must check after browser validation passes
entry.summary: Keep immediate input feedback separate from server authorization and current-state acceptance.

entry.title: Why downstream work can survive an upstream timeout
entry.summary: Propagate remaining budgets, stop spawned work and handle committed effects separately from RPC cancellation.

entry.title: Resuming a download without joining two file versions
entry.summary: Bind saved bytes to a representation and separate append, replacement and integrity checks.

entry.title: A valid JWT signature does not establish the intended recipient
entry.summary: Validate intended issuer, audience and purpose, then authorize the requested resource separately.

entry.title: Password-hash upgrades need a migration path, not just a new name
entry.summary: Plan legacy verification, authenticated upgrades, dormant-account recovery and rollback compatibility together.

entry.title: A completed click is not a completed business operation
entry.summary: Wait for rereadable business outcomes rather than treating a completed click or transient notice as durable success.

entry.title: Plural rules select categories, not translated sentences
entry.summary: Select complete localized messages, keeping cardinal, ordinal, zero-state and unknown-count semantics distinct.

entry.title: An unchanged transaction timestamp is not a stopped clock
entry.summary: Match transaction, statement and observation timestamps to the event each field is meant to record.

entry.title: Choose cascading deletion from ownership, not convenience
entry.summary: Choose referential deletion from lifetimes, shared references and recovery requirements.

entry.title: Savepoints do not replace a partial-import report
entry.summary: Partial imports need stable input identities and trustworthy commit reports beyond local savepoint recovery.

entry.title: An incident action closes when its risk reduction is checked
entry.summary: Tie incident actions to failure paths and falsifiable acceptance, without equating closed tasks with quantified risk reduction.

entry.title: A broader fixture scope also broadens shared state
entry.summary: Broader fixture reuse needs explicit initial state, failure cleanup and external-resource isolation.

entry.title: 发现阶段结束，不一定意味着进入开发
entry.summary: 发现阶段需要同时定义继续与停止条件，以问题、约束和关键未知决定是否进入下一步，而非为既定方案补报告。

entry.title: 接口返回 202，什么时候才能说任务完成？
entry.summary: 202 表示接受而非完成；异步接口还需定义接受承诺、终态查询、授权和超时恢复，避免把提交成功误作业务完成。

entry.title: 错误信息可读，客户端为什么仍无法采取动作？
entry.summary: HTTP 问题详情应区分稳定机器类型与可读说明，核对状态、权限和未知类型处理，不公开底层调试细节。

entry.title: 只招熟悉产品的人，研究会漏掉什么？
entry.summary: 招募覆盖怎样影响研究结论：区分可接触用户与目标人群，记录失败者、支持需求和证据缺口。

entry.title: Ending discovery can justify stopping rather than starting development
entry.summary: Define continuation and stopping conditions from the problem, constraints and decisive unknowns.

entry.title: HTTP 202 acknowledges processing, not a completed business result
entry.summary: HTTP 202 needs an explicit acceptance promise, terminal-state retrieval, authorization and uncertainty recovery.

entry.title: Error text needs a stable machine-readable decision boundary
entry.summary: Separate stable problem types from readable detail and verify status, permissions and unknown-type handling.

entry.title: Research only with familiar users leaves predictable gaps
entry.summary: Recruit beyond familiar users, preserve unsuccessful journeys and report who remains outside the evidence.

entry.title: 下载到了构建产物，怎样确认它就是本次批准的版本？
entry.summary: GitHub Actions 产物交接应绑定运行身份、不可变产物与摘要，摘要匹配只证明内容关联，不替代来源和发布授权。

entry.title: 架构决定变了，旧 ADR 应该删除吗？
entry.summary: 旧 ADR 应保留原始背景并明确标记替代关系，把当前决定、迁移状态与重新评估条件分开记录。

entry.title: CSP 报告没有告警，就能直接切到强制阻断吗？
entry.summary: CSP 观察模式不执行该策略的阻断；报告为空需先验证采集与业务覆盖，再灰度核验执行策略及回退。

entry.title: Cookie 配了 SameSite，还需要 CSRF 防护吗？
entry.summary: SameSite 应结合应用条件评估，自动携带身份的写入请求仍需核对令牌、来源和子域信任边界。

entry.title: 用了 Docker secret mount，镜像里就绝不会泄露密钥吗？
entry.summary: Docker 构建密钥挂载保护输入通道，仍需审查命令输出、生成文件、镜像层和缓存，防止进程主动复制秘密。

entry.title: 排查需要上下文，怎样避免日志变成第二份敏感数据库？
entry.summary: 日志应记录操作、授权结果与关联标识，限制原始凭据和个人资料，并核对采集前脱敏、访问权限与保留范围。

entry.title: 弹窗能关闭，键盘用户为什么找不到原来的位置？
entry.summary: 模态弹窗需定义焦点进入、内部循环和退出后的逻辑位置；ARIA 标记必须与真实交互行为一致。

entry.title: 写了 readOnly，服务端就会拒绝修改吗？
entry.summary: OpenAPI 3.1.1 的 readOnly 是注解，业务接口仍需明确忽略或拒绝策略，并在实际写入路径验证受保护字段。

entry.title: 改用尾部采样，就能找回已经丢掉的错误链路吗？
entry.summary: OpenTelemetry 尾部采样只能判断收到的数据；头部丢弃、路由分散和等待窗口都会影响错误链路保留，需要同时验证资源与完整性。

entry.title: 加了行锁仍然死锁：所有入口是否按同一顺序拿锁？
entry.summary: PostgreSQL 18 会中止死锁中的一个事务；一致拿锁顺序需要覆盖全部写入入口，重试应回到完整业务事务边界。

entry.title: JSONB 有 GIN 索引，为什么键存在查询仍可能用不上？
entry.summary: PostgreSQL 18 的 JSONB 索引选择需核对操作符类、表达式和业务查询，不能把更小的索引当成覆盖全部请求的保证。

entry.title: 翻页有重复：LIMIT 之外还要约定什么？
entry.summary: PostgreSQL 18 的 LIMIT 需要唯一排序；游标减少位置漂移，但稳定数据导出仍需额外定义快照和可变排序字段。

entry.title: 唯一约束存在，为什么还能保存两个空值？
entry.summary: PostgreSQL 18 默认把唯一约束中的 NULL 视为不同值，业务需明确未知、未分配与空字符串的含义再选择约束。

entry.title: 点击增加了，任务完成了吗？产品指标先定义分母
entry.summary: 产品指标先定义用户收益、尝试单位和完成条件，保留跨日、重试与线下结果，避免点击增长掩盖任务失败。

entry.title: 每个订单都加一个指标标签，排查会更方便吗？
entry.summary: Prometheus 标签组合会增加时间序列，订单与用户等无界维度应先估算增长，再用聚合指标与事件记录分担排查职责。

entry.title: Promise.all 已经失败，其他请求为什么还在执行？
entry.summary: Promise.all 聚合失败不会取消已经开始的任务；需区分可取消读取、业务写入与完整结果收集，避免重试重复副作用。

entry.title: Terraform 状态锁拿到了，云资源就不会被别人修改吗？
entry.summary: Terraform 状态锁协调同一状态的写入，不等于禁止控制台或其他状态修改资源；解锁前必须确认实际拥有者和运行结果。

entry.title: 时间戳带了时区偏移，能表达每天九点吗？
entry.summary: 一次发生的时间与重复日历规则应分开保存，时间戳中的偏移不能独自定义未来本地时间的执行意图。

entry.title: 上传接口只收图片，扩展名和 MIME 检查够吗？
entry.summary: 上传文件应先进入隔离状态，结合类型、解析资源、存储位置与下载授权检查，避免把入口判断当成全程安全。

entry.title: 演示顺利不等于用户会用：怎样写不泄露答案的测试任务
entry.summary: 可用性测试应给出真实目标而非操作提示，分别记录独立完成、主持人帮助与错误恢复，再决定修复优先级。

entry.title: Downloading an artifact is not proof it is the approved build
entry.summary: Bind approval to a specific workflow run and artifact digest, then verify that same object at deployment.

entry.title: When architecture changes, keep the superseded ADR
entry.summary: Preserve the old decision, link its replacement, and separate architectural intent from migration completion.

entry.title: No CSP reports does not prove an enforcement policy is ready
entry.summary: Verify reporting and workflow coverage before enforcing CSP; an empty report stream is not proof of safety.

entry.title: Is SameSite alone enough to prevent CSRF?
entry.summary: Evaluate SameSite against the application threat model and protect state-changing requests with explicit checks.

entry.title: A Docker secret mount cannot prevent a command from leaking its input
entry.summary: Secret mounts protect a build input channel; inspect commands, output files and caches for copied credentials.

entry.title: Keep diagnostic evidence without creating a second sensitive database
entry.summary: Log decisions and correlation identifiers while controlling sensitive fields, access and retention.

entry.title: A dialog can close while leaving keyboard users lost
entry.summary: Define dialog entry, contained keyboard navigation and the next focus destination, matching semantics to behavior.

entry.title: Does readOnly in OpenAPI actually prevent a write?
entry.summary: In OpenAPI 3.1.1, readOnly is an annotation; define and verify the actual server-side write policy.

entry.title: Tail sampling cannot recover traces already discarded upstream
entry.summary: Tail sampling selects received traces; upstream drops, routing and decision windows still constrain error coverage.

entry.title: Row locks can still deadlock: order resources across every entry point
entry.summary: Prevent PostgreSQL deadlocks with consistent resource ordering across writers, and retry at the transaction boundary.

entry.title: A JSONB GIN index does not support every query shape
entry.summary: Match PostgreSQL JSONB operator classes and indexed expressions to real queries before evaluating cost.

entry.title: Pagination needs a unique order and a cross-page consistency policy
entry.summary: Use a unique order for PostgreSQL pagination, and define what concurrent changes may do between pages.

entry.title: Why can a unique column still contain multiple NULLs?
entry.summary: PostgreSQL 18 treats NULLs as distinct in unique constraints by default; choose semantics before enforcing identity.

entry.title: More clicks, fewer completed tasks? Define the denominator first
entry.summary: Define attempts, completion and observation windows before interpreting a rise in product clicks.

entry.title: One metric label per order turns monitoring into an event database
entry.summary: Budget label combinations before exposing metrics, and keep unbounded event identities in suitable diagnostic storage.

entry.title: Promise.all rejection does not cancel the remaining work
entry.summary: Promise.all aggregates outcomes; cancellation, compensation and complete result collection need separate policies.

entry.title: Terraform state locking does not freeze the cloud
entry.summary: State locking coordinates a state backend, not every cloud writer; establish ownership before clearing a lock.

entry.title: A timestamp offset cannot fully express “every day at nine”
entry.summary: Store an occurrence separately from recurring calendar intent, and define how local-time ambiguities are handled.

entry.title: Image uploads need more than extension and MIME checks
entry.summary: Quarantine untrusted uploads and review parsing, storage and retrieval permissions as well as file type.

entry.title: A smooth demo does not prove usability: write tasks without giving the answer
entry.summary: Test the goal without giving away the route, and distinguish independent completion from moderator assistance.

entry.title: 依赖缓存命中了，为什么仍要重新校验安装？
entry.summary: GitHub Actions 缓存应视为可丢弃的加速输入，锁文件、来源与信任边界仍需验证，不能代替发布制品。

entry.title: 两次发布交叉执行：并发组该锁分支还是环境？
entry.summary: 部署并发分组应对应共享环境，取消任务不能替代状态核验，也不能默认当作完整发布队列。

entry.title: 流水线没传令牌，第三方 Action 就拿不到权限吗？
entry.summary: GitHub Actions 的令牌可通过上下文访问，需按 job 明确最小权限，并区分只读构建和写入发布。

entry.title: 两个人都保存成功，为什么一个人的修改消失了？
entry.summary: 用强 ETag 和 If-Match 显式识别旧版本保存，并解释原子比较、权限检查与用户冲突处理的边界。

entry.title: 请求超时后能否重试？先定义业务幂等边界
entry.summary: 超时后的结果未知怎样处理：区分 HTTP 幂等语义、业务意图标识、持久化去重与外部副作用。

entry.title: 搜索结果倒退了：取消请求还不够，提交状态也要验身份
entry.summary: 前端搜索怎样处理乱序响应：取消无用请求、识别当前意图，并保护成功、错误和加载状态的写入。

entry.title: 设置 no-cache 后仍有缓存文件，是配置错了吗？
entry.summary: 区分 HTTP 缓存的存储与重用：解释 no-cache、no-store、private，并按实际请求链路验证策略。

entry.title: 订单编号换成 UUID，就能防止越权访问吗？
entry.summary: UUID 只能降低猜测难度，不能代替对象级授权；用双账号与权限变化场景核对每个访问入口。

entry.title: 用户说“会用”就立项？先追问最近一次任务
entry.summary: 用户访谈怎样从赞同转向行为证据：追问最近一次任务，区分观察、推论与待验证的需求假设。

entry.title: 数据库一慢就重启所有 Pod，探针是否问错了问题？
entry.summary: Kubernetes 启动、就绪与存活探针触发不同动作，外部依赖变慢不应未经分析就导致重启风暴。

entry.title: 节点 CPU 不忙，容器请求为什么仍然变慢？
entry.summary: Kubernetes requests 与 limits 作用不同，节点平均利用率不能替代容器限流、内存及请求排队证据。

entry.title: 配置 preStop 后仍丢请求：退出时间预算怎么算？
entry.summary: Kubernetes 优雅终止要统筹 preStop、停止接收、在途请求与清理，睡眠不能替代业务排空核验。

entry.title: 链路上下文方便透传，为什么不能直接塞客户邮箱？
entry.summary: Baggage 会跨服务传播，且不自带完整性保证；需区分传播、属性持久化、敏感信息与授权身份。

entry.title: 生产建索引用了 CONCURRENTLY，为什么还在等？
entry.summary: PostgreSQL 18 并发建索引仍有事务等待、资源开销和失败状态，需要以有效性及业务负载验收。

entry.title: 慢查询先加索引？先看估算行数错在哪里
entry.summary: 如何用 PostgreSQL 18 EXPLAIN 建立慢查询证据，区分估算偏差、真实执行成本与索引直觉。

entry.title: 事务都提交了，业务约束为什么仍被破坏？
entry.summary: 以值班约束分析 PostgreSQL 18 的并发事务：从不变量选择保护方式，并把可串行化重试纳入设计。
